name: Backward Pass for Gaussian Gradients
definition: Computes gradients of a scalar loss L with respect to input Gaussian parameters (color c, opacity o, mean μ, scale s, rotation q) by propagating pixel gradients backward using chain rule and Frobenius inner product.
summary: Backward Pass for Gaussian Gradients computes exact gradients for Gaussian parameters by propagating pixel gradients back-to-front through the alpha-compositing rasterizer to correctly account for occlusion.
